module: Manages "selectability" presets of object types in the world editor: which object classes (TSStatic, Prefab, BeamNGVehicle...) can be clicked/selected. Presets: current, all, staticsAndProps (BeamNGVehicle, Prefab, PrefabInstance, TSStatic), default (mask captured at the first initialization). It reads/writes via editor.getObjectTypeSelectable / setObjectTypeSelectable and the gizmos.visualization.selectable preference. A tool can temporarily take control of the mask with beginScope/endScope.
usage:
local sp = extensions.editor_api_selectabilityPresets
local owner = {}
if sp.beginScope(owner, 'staticsAndProps', 'My tool') then
  -- ... work ...
  sp.endScope(owner)
end
notes: The module uses the global editor (not declared locally) and worldEditorCppApi.getObjectClassNames() for the class list.
The 'current' preset is not applicable: applyPreset and beginScope return false for it.
During a scope, applyPreset with a different owner is refused, markCurrent and syncActivePresetFromMask return false, and the drawControls buttons are disabled.
The 'default' preset is the mask captured on the first call of initialize (so the state at the time of first use, not a fixed value).

initialize.desc: Captures the current selectability mask as the "default" mask if not already captured. Called automatically by the other functions.

applyPreset.desc: Applies a preset (all, staticsAndProps or default) to the selectability mask. If persist is true and no scope is active, also saves the mask in the preferences.

persist.desc: Save to the gizmos.visualization.selectable preference (and to disk if saveVisualizationSettings is active).

owner.desc: Scope owner: must match the current owner if a scope is active.

returns.desc: true if applied, false if unknown preset/'current' or scope held by another.

beginScope.desc: Temporarily takes control of the mask: saves the current mask and preferences then applies the preset, without persisting it. If the scope already exists, returns whether the owner is the same.

owner.desc: Table identifying the caller (compared by identity).

ownerLabel.desc: Name displayed in drawControls ("X is temporarily controlling this mask").

returns.desc: true if the scope is active for this owner.

endScope.desc: Ends the scope: restores the saved mask, preferences and active preset, then saves the preferences if saveVisualizationSettings is active.

returns.desc: true if restored, false if there is no scope or another owner.

getScopeOwner.desc: Returns the owner of the active scope, or nil.

isScoped.desc: Indicates whether a temporary scope is active.

returns.desc: true if a scope is active.

markCurrent.desc: Marks the active preset as 'current' (mask modified by hand). No effect during a scope.

returns.desc: false if a scope is active, otherwise true.

syncActivePresetFromMask.desc: Compares the actual mask to the all, staticsAndProps, default presets and sets activePresetId to the first that matches, otherwise 'current'.

returns.desc: false if a scope is active, otherwise true.

getActivePresetId.desc: Returns the id of the active preset.

getActivePresetLabel.desc: Returns the displayable label of the active preset.

drawControls.desc: Draws in ImGui the "Presets" button row: All, Statics and Props, Restore Default (with persistence). Disabled during a scope, with a text indicating who controls the mask. To be called from an editor window.
